# Property getter

Reads a setting by property key (d0) and index (d1) from a RAM registry.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x6005e971` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md)

Settings have no fixed RAM address. The getter by settings id is 0x602cbc0a.
